jobs.occupation: Engine Assembly Technician
jobs.description:
Mission Brief 
As a Mechanical Technician at our rocket engine test site in Kiruna, you will play a vital role in supporting engine development and flight test operations. You will help operate, maintain, and upgrade state-of-the-art test facilities, engines, and related components. Your work will directly contribute to the safe and efficient testing of rocket engines and support our broader space mission.
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Perform assembly, maintenance, calibration, and repair of mechanical systems—including test rigs, rocket engines, high-pressure gas systems, and facility infrastructure.
Support test operations by preparing mechanical systems—including test rigs, rocket engines, high-pressure gas systems, and facility infrastructure.
Support commissioning, pressure testing, and engine hotfire activities by preparing equipment, following operational procedures, and documenting results.
Troubleshoot mechanical issues with engines and test facility systems, collaborating with your team and other functions (e.g., engineering, logistics) to resolve problems efficiently.
Assist with the installation and configuration of test equipment, ensuring correct setup for various test scenarios.
Follow established operational and safety procedures to ensure all activities are conducted safely and in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance, calibration, test activities, and incidents, as per company policy.
Participate in regular safety briefings and training to maintain high standards of competence.
Proactively suggest improvements to processes, tooling, and equipment to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency.
Maintain the cleanliness, organization, and readiness of work areas, tools, and equipment.

Qualification Checklist 

At least 3 years of experience in a technical, hands-on mechanical role (preferably in aerospace, energy, or high-pressure systems).
Practical experience with hazardous systems/environments (e.g., cryogenics, pyrophorics, explosive atmospheres) is highly valued.
Hands-on experience with high-pressure gas systems: assembly, commissioning, leak checking, and operation.
Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency in the use of hand and power tools, measurement instruments, and test equipment.
Familiarity with maintenance and troubleshooting of complex mechanical and fluid systems.
Basic proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings, schematics, and procedures.
Safety-conscious mindset and knowledge of relevant safety regulations and compliance standards.
Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Bonus Skills
Experience in a development test environment, especially with cryogenics and high-pressure gas systems.
Relevant technical education, certifications, or licenses.
Experience with CAD software and MS Office suite.
Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Strong problem-solving skills and initiative

jobs.occupation: Hostel / Hotel Manager
jobs.description:
HOSTEL / HOTEL MANAGER
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Hostel / Hotel Manager to join our growing hospitality company in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining team management with the practical, day-to-day operation of a hostel.
Who we are looking for
Fluent and confident in English, both spoken and written.
Preferably 3+ years of experience in hospitality, including experience in a managerial or supervisory role.
Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.
Follows the set procedures and makes sure that his team does so as well.
Comfortable using computers, basic Excel and different online systems and tools.
Confident managing, supporting and motivating a small team.
Hands-on and willing to help with cleaning, maintenance or other practical tasks when needed.
Positive, communicative and social, with an interest in travel, hospitality and meeting people from around the world.
Able to work independently, take initiative and solve problems as they arise.

The role
As Hostel / Hotel Manager, you are responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the property. Your responsibilities include:
Managing and overseeing a small on-site team of 1–3 people.
Working in the hostel reception and assisting guests when needed.
Planning staff schedules and coordinating daily tasks.
Overseeing daily operations, supplies, linen orders and general organization.
Ensuring that rooms and common areas meet our cleanliness and quality standards.
Assisting with cleaning when needed.
Handling minor maintenance and practical issues.
Communicating and coordinating with our online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel's operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. As manager, you have flexibility to organize your own schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company operating hostels in central Stockholm, with the ambition to build an international hostel group characterized by Scandinavian design and the Nomad concept.
Our organization combines an on-site team with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are excellent opportunities to grow with the company and take on greater responsibility as we expand.
What we offer
Salary: 30,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in an international environment, meet people from all over the world and have the opportunity to develop your management, hospitality and communication skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

jobs.occupation: Specialist Doctors in General Practice Wanted for Region Dalarna, Sweden

Region Dalarna is the largest employer in the region with more than 8,500 employees and four hospitals in Avesta, Falun, Ludvika and Mora, as well as a large network of primary care centres.

Specialists in General Practice / Family Medicine
Family Physicians interested in long-term careers in Sweden

Be a licensed specialist doctor in General Practice within the EU/EEA
